experience.summary: Leading enterprise frontend micro-architectures, client engagements, and rendering performance optimizations across business-critical digital suites.
highlights: Spearheaded 4+ enterprise client implementations, architecting modular React frontend micro-frontends with a 95% client satisfaction rate.
Led sprint technical scoping and direct client engagements, translating functional requirements into UI roadmaps with zero delivery slippage.
Engineered Accounts Payable Automation frontend with React.js & Redux Toolkit, building 10+ reusable components cutting rollout cycles by 20%.
Accelerated site rendering speeds by 5x utilizing web speculation rules, windowed list virtualization, and debounced filter pipelines.
Automated CI/CD pipelines via Azure DevOps and SAP BTP, decreasing deployment failures by 30% with standardized build quality gates.
Mentored junior engineers across 15+ technical KT sessions on React state management, lifecycle patterns, and enterprise debugging.

experience.summary: Built high-throughput analytics dashboards and automated B2B invoicing integrations for top-tier enterprise clients.
highlights: Developed responsive, role-based analytics dashboards featuring dynamic KPI data visualizations, cutting executive reporting latency by 40%.
Implemented automated E-Invoice workflows integrated with supplier PO endpoints, speeding invoice reconciliation for 50+ enterprise vendors.
Built reusable UI modules conforming to enterprise design standards using React.js, Material-UI, and Tailwind CSS.

experience.summary: Space research and telemetry engineering at the Indian Space Research Organisation ground stations.
highlights: Simulated S-band Microstrip Patch Array Antennas (2–4 GHz) using HFSS and CST, improving antenna gain by 18% and bandwidth efficiency by 15%.
Monitored live telemetry data feeds and executed standardized satellite command sequence checks for Low Earth Orbit (LEO) passes at ISTRAC operations.

projects.title: LOOK – Salon Booking Platform
projects.description: High-concurrency mobile marketplace connecting users with beauty salons, featuring real-time slot scheduling, instant discovery, and offline sync.
details: Built cross-platform mobile UI in React Native featuring fluid animations, localized caching, and persistent offline state management.
Integrated Elasticsearch indexing for multi-parameter salon and slot availability searches, reducing query response times by 70%.
Engineered event-driven booking pipeline with Apache Kafka, reducing inter-service latency by 30% with idempotent transactions.
Containerized microservices via Docker and orchestrated on Kubernetes, maintaining 99.5% service uptime across clusters.

Implemented windowed virtualization and speculative route pre-fetching for instant pagination across 10,000+ line items.
Created an extensible component library cutting release turnaround from weeks to days.

Designed standardized responsive UI widgets with Material-UI and custom CSS design tokens.
